compartments.text_span: Represents the population of infected individuals. The model calculates the number of new infections per day based on past infections via a renewal equation, as shown in the 'modelled infections' box in the model diagram.
compartments.description: Represents the population of infected individuals. The model calculates the number of new infections per day based on past infections via a renewal equation, as shown in the 'modelled infections' box in the model diagram.

compartments.text_span: Represents the population of individuals who have died from the infection. The model calculates daily deaths based on past infections, an infection-to-death distribution, and an infection fatality ratio, as shown in the 'modelled deaths' box in the model diagram.
compartments.description: Represents the population of individuals who have died from the infection. The model calculates daily deaths based on past infections, an infection-to-death distribution, and an infection fatality ratio, as shown in the 'modelled deaths' box in the model diagram.

flows.raw_text: Generation of new infections from existing infectious individuals. The number of new infections is modelled as the product of the time-varying reproduction number (R_t) with a discrete convolution of the previous infections, weighted by the serial interval distribution.

parameters.text_span: Time-varying reproduction number, modelled as a piecewise constant function that changes when an intervention occurs.
